answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network anchors identity verification to a cryptographic trellis of staked deposits where registration burns tokens on a superlinear curve, C(k) = b * k^(1.5). Validation gateways at each consensus wharf impose this exponential friction, forcing attacker replication costs to scale quadratically against finite yield.
